defense_news.title: US clears way for $24.3 billion fighter jet sale to Saudi Arabia
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Department of State said on Thursday it had approved the potential sale of Lockheed Martin’s F-35 Lightning II fighter jets to Saudi Arabia.

defense_news.title: US Air Force has a $14 billion supply hole, service officials say
defense_news.summary: As the force grapples with supply chain and maintenance issues, sustainment funding to fill the $14 billion gap is becoming increasingly necessary.

defense_news.title: Latvia chooses Czech howitzers over Swedish Archer offer
defense_news.summary: Latvia will buy Czech Morana 155 mm howitzers, reversing an earlier decision to by the rival Archer artillery weapon from Sweden's BAE Systems Bofors.
